# Complete realtime and lane policy traversal before accepting its results

Queued child of #402; grandparents #306/#349 TOOL-11. This is issue #410; the matching numbered local spec and GitHub body are synchronized before implementation. Depends on merged #400 (a9e801fe), #371 and #406. Assign only after #406 merges, to serialize shared-helper changes. Freeze actual main/helper API at assignment, including any independently merged #399 markers. This issue is not a prerequisite for #399.

## Closable outcome and allowed paths

The realtime and lane gates cannot pass after failed or partial traversal while their existing safety/numeric rules remain identical. Only `scripts/check-realtime-policy.sh`, `scripts/check-lane-policy.sh`, `scripts/test-realtime-policy.sh`, `scripts/test-lane-policy.sh`, minimal `scripts/lib/gate.sh` / `scripts/test-gate-lib.sh` extensions, and this numbered spec/evidence. No Rust, manifests, artifacts, other gate or workflow edits. Both named suites are already required-CI entry points in qualification.yml; shared helper tests are already reached through test-workspace-policy.sh. Preserve that wiring without duplicate calls.

## Frozen semantics

Realtime: foundation `crates/engine/src/realtime` and all four scan roots crates/hosts/tools/sidecars are required. Capture unsafe source-search status before the exact allowlist filters; successful empty matches/filter results pass. Capture complete marked-file rg/sort output before looping. Preserve the 12-file/42-region floors unless an independently landed upward change has actual evidence. Check each begin/end-count read and awk region-body extraction separately; zero END matches is an unmatched-marker failure, read failure is an execution failure. Preserve marker grammar, exact unsafe paths and ban regex. Do not invent a nonempty-body rule, transitive-callgraph claim, new marker or malformed-marker grammar. An individual empty body remains legal under current rules.

Lane: capture each whole-tree source scan before its existing exemptions/filtering; clean filtered-empty matches pass. Required `crates/lane/src` Rust discovery must complete and be nonempty before the per-file five-line marker-window awk scan; marker hits remain forbidden. Capture each awk read even if some earlier source already succeeded. Preserve the two allowed marker/evidence families and every existing regex.

The root Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock remain required; preserve exact wide 1.6.1 pin and existing bytemuck/safe_arch version-presence checks. Capture locked_version and locked_dependencies errors before equality tests or consumer loops. Both locked_dependencies consumers belong here, not only the find loops. The dependency-list policies remain allowlists, not newly exact lists: do not demand additional list members while hardening scans. Successful empty dependency output is distinct from tool/read failure and retains its current allowlist meaning. Workspace package-name discovery across required crates/hosts/tools/sidecars must complete and yield a nonempty aggregate; an individual empty root is legal. Preserve package-name parsing, exact dependency matching and all manifest/lock grammar.

## Directed verification

Retain all existing realtime/lane mutations and real-tree positives. Add missing root with otherwise valid fixture metadata; match-plus-missing-root; source producer that emits valid partial output then fails; discovered-file read/awk error; per-file count error; marker discovery error even when partial output already satisfies 12/42; lock extractor failure after valid output; and workspace manifest discovery error after valid names. Prove complete empty unsafe/filter results pass and zero required source discovery fails. Keep the current empty allowed dependency-list behavior explicit in its fixture.

Each red assertion must name the intended failure class and explicitly reject unexpected success, not accept arbitrary tool/syntax failure. A counter-mutation for each new helper failure mechanism proves the test rejects the original silent acceptance. Use controlled executable failures where chmod is ineffective under privileged execution. Add no generic harness. Run both real gates, both existing suites, helper suite if API changes, bash syntax/diff, retained full-workspace unchanged-count comparison and required CI. No timing or artifact repin.

## Shared delivery contract

All command-producing operations must distinguish successful output, successful allowed emptiness and execution failure before any filter/count/consumer can certify a result. Never depend on caller pipefail/errexit, conditional-function behavior, standalone ! assertions or lost process-substitution status. Preserve stderr/status evidence, exact regex/glob/allowlist semantics, physical-script helper sourcing before fixture-root cd, caller options/cwd and existing CLI. Do not filter required roots down to those present or mkdir around a missing input. Minimal common helpers only; no command-runner/parser framework.

Astra scopes and reviews; Luna gets one coherent implementation attempt, Sol at most two retries only after FAIL, then hard stop/rescope. Root owns isolated worktrees, exact-path checkpoints/pushes, status/issue synchronization and merge; pause at coherent green tranche before layering more edits. No active shared-helper edits overlap #406 or another tooling child. Full qualification is immutable and shared-target Cargo is serialized. Astra reviews the actual pushed PR head and required CI must succeed before merge.

Each child closes its named concrete outcome only after upstream evidence and PASS. #402 remains OPEN until all three children account for all six original gates, with no silent producer or policy-coverage omission. #306 and #349 TOOL-11 remain OPEN through their other children. The serialized children are #410 (realtime/lane), #411 (unfused), and #412 (environment/migration/research); #410 follows merged #406. No implementation is authorized merely by publishing this queued brief.
